channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily digest of tech opinions and blog posts curated for Yun Zhou

item.title: Cory Doctorow: Formalities
item.description: Doctorow, for the first time in 25 years, cheers the US Copyright Office: its human-authorship-only stance means AI-heavy work forces companies to track every AI-generated pixel and word — privately rebuilding the copyright formalities Berne abolished.

item.title: Parameter Labs: Do the Math — How We Took Over ChatGPT Accounts
item.description: A crafted ChatGPT share link ran code as chatgpt.com in the victim's session — via a MathLive message listener that accepted HTML from any frame plus a YouTube JSONP CSP bypass — reading private chats; OpenAI fixed it Oct 26 and paid a $5,000 bounty.

item.title: Martin Fowler: LLM Voice
item.description: Fowler names the 'uncanny valley of prose' in LLM writing and argues authors should never let a model write even a first draft — human editing rarely expels the machine voice; an outline is as far as it should go.
